name: How long does it take to replace sliding windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace sliding windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of sliding window replacement depends on the number of windows, their size, the complexity of the installation, and crew size. For a typical residential project, replacing a few standard sliding windows might take one to two days. A whole-house replacement can take several days to a week or more. Factors like unexpected structural issues or custom window orders can also extend the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies based on the number and size of windows, and project complexity. A few windows might take 1-2 days, while a whole house could take several days to a week.
